data.body: Correction to the preceding completion trail: Gerrit change 2903 / Change-Id Ib816a71188f7134a993f3aae2d48054a964db4bf reviewed patch-set commit 935a25fbc44d44be97b73594cdfd3e46d635e279. That revision had LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and zero unresolved comments before revision-scoped submit. Gerrit's server-side Rebase-If-Necessary merge produced commit 6a8d6a52a3969ae44cd6539f571892926b86c647, whose parent is 3addff32e8ee61e2512d43246b66543a465e37ca; the merged commit is reachable from origin/main. The immutable 58-row receipt remains tied to the reviewed patch-set SHA, while completion verification should use the merged SHA.
